selection: 50 evenly spaced ranks including endpoints, after deduplicating sequences and sorting original combined score; original trajectory.csv, all sequence-designed phases, exclude initialization cycle00
ligand: fluorescein hydroxyethylamide; Boltz-affinity-standardized chemical state shared by both models
comparison: native production scoring protocols, not a matched-FLOP or diffusion-step comparison; settings fixed within each model and candidate sequence/seed/ligand identical
timing: wall time around resident request to complete receipt; include preprocessing, ESM for NESSO, prediction, affinity and normal output/geometry validation; exclude process startup, first warmup, experiment integrity hashing; no parallel model workers
ranking: NESSO P(bind)+(1-entropy_crop_pl), invalid or <=1e-6 entropy excluded; Boltz P(bind)+ligand_pLDDT/100
limits: one ligand, related designs, score-range-stratified sample, one timing pass, fixed model order; exploratory agreement, not experimental affinity validation
